messages:
mara: Quick heads-up — we’re publishing the 'Latency at Scale' blog + benchmark tomorrow. Embargo lifts 10:00 PT. Posting job queued. Need press monitoring, social amplification, and rapid response notes. Assets + tracking doc: https://go.redwood.com/launch-assets :wave:

Diane: PR team ready. I’ll be the primary reporter contact. Who's covering monitoring and who has the final headline? Also add the approved quote for announcing SLA improvements. :ok_hand:

Sam: I can own the launch ops checklist and make sure the deploys are green. Will add a step to notify eng-oncall if any benchmark anomalies pop up. @lin — can eng be on standby 09:30-12:00 PT?

Lin: Eng on standby 09:30-12:00 PT. We’ll watch perf dashboards and tracing. If we see >20% latency regression we’ll rollback to the smaller quantized variant and open a P0.

press-bot: Deploy job queued: blog_publish_job#4421 scheduled for 10:00 PT (thread 1990012345). Notifying marketing-live and press-surge channels automatically.

Alex: Social copy ready, holding for final headline. Two variants: short tweet + longer thread. Can drop snippets here when final. Also prepared a 1-min explainer video file (mp4) in the assets doc.

mara: Pasting embargo copy and top-line Q/A for reporters — use as the canonical responses. Please copy into the tracking doc.

mara: ```
Embargo lift 10:00 PT. Key messages:
- Redwood Inference reduced median token latency by ~35% on our benchmark for long-context models.
- New runtime improvements available for Hosted and Dedicated customers today.
- We validated cost drop across common seq lengths; full methodology in the benchmark appendix.
Reporter Qs:
Q: How did you measure latency?
A: Public benchmark harness + internal traces; see appendix for config and raw logs.
Q: Any impact on quality?
A: No measurable drop in our evals; details in section 4.
```

Diane: This looks good. I added two press contacts and suggested reporter follow-ups in the doc. Will route any interview requests to me.

elaine: Monitoring plan: rotate 30-min checks on press-surge and marketing-live from 09:45-12:15 PT. I’ll take the first 30. If anything climbs, we escalate to eng-oncall + press. I’ll post a pinned checklist in marketing-live.

Sam: Ops checklist snippet (for tracking doc) — pasting so it's available to everyone:
```
- 09:00 PT: run pre-publish smoke (end-to-end generate + embed)
- 09:30 PT: eng standby confirmed
- 09:45 PT: monitoring rotation begins
- 10:00 PT: embargo lift, publish job fires
- 10:05 PT: verify CDN + blog page 200 + sample generation
- 10:15 PT: check perf dashboards for regressions
- 10:30 PT: confirm social posts and press mentions captured
- If regression >20%: trigger rollback + alert press contact
```

Alex: Dropping our two social variants here — use the short one for org account, long for thread: 
- Short: "We just cut median token latency ~35% on long-context workloads. New runtime optimizations rolling out today. Read more: go.redwood.com/latency" :rocket: 
- Long thread: (will post after headline confirmed)

Diane: One last ask — please mark any tickets about press/visibility as P0 and add the tag 'press-visibility' so we don’t miss them.

mara: Perfect. Thanks everyone. I’ll send a final pre-publish ping 09:50 PT with the headline. If you’re covering monitoring, head to marketing-live and press-surge once the job runs. :pray:
